summary: Talk to Amanda, stage 1. Reuses the existing conversation store (claire_sessions / claire_session_turns) for owner conversations with Amanda: a new surface 'conversation', channel / provider / provider conversation id, measured metrics, measured cost and audio seconds, finalized_at; turns gain the 'teammate' speaker, per-turn latency and tools used. New amanda_memory table (workpaper) for what Amanda keeps between conversations. agent_runs.run_kind gains 'conversation' for one usage row per conversation. No existing row's data changes.

preflight.name: amanda_memory does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'amanda_memory'

preflight.name: claire_sessions has no provider_conversation_id column yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'claire_sessions' AND column_name = 'provider_conversation_id'

expected_changes: claire_sessions: surface CHECK now also allows 'conversation'; adds nullable channel (CHECK voice|text|phone|email), provider, provider_conversation_id, metrics, cost_usd, audio_seconds, finalized_at; two partial indexes.
claire_session_turns: speaker CHECK now also allows 'teammate'; adds nullable latency_ms and tool_calls.
Creates amanda_memory (RLS on, service_role SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE, updated_at trigger) with four indexes.
agent_runs: run_kind CHECK now also allows 'conversation'.

verify.name: no existing session is on the new surface
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM claire_sessions WHERE surface = 'conversation'

verify.name: the conversation run kind is allowed
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'agent_runs_run_kind_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%conversation%'
